mapper.select: SELECT A.SHIFT_DATE,B.RED_COUNT,B.RED_FOUP_LIST,B.YELLOW_COUNT,B.YELLOW_FOUP_LIST,B.GREEN_COUNT ,B.RATIO FROM( SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE)-ROWNUM+1,'YYYYMMDD')SHIFT_DATE FROM DUAL CONNECT BY ROWNUM<=31 )A LEFT JOIN( SELECT SHIFT_DATE,MAX(RED_COUNT)RED_COUNT,MAX(RED_FOUP_LIST)RED_FOUP_LIST ,MAX(YELLOW_COUNT)YELLOW_COUNT,MAX(YELLOW_FOUP_LIST)YELLOW_FOUP_LIST,MAX(GREEN_COUNT)GREEN_COUNT ,CASE WHEN SUM(COLOR_COUNT)>0 THEN ROUND(MAX(GREEN_COUNT)*100/SUM(COLOR_COUNT),1) END RATIO FROM( SELECT SHIFT_DATE,COLOR,COUNT(1)COLOR_COUNT ,CASE WHEN COLOR <>'GREEN' THEN LISTAGG(FOUP_CATEGORY,',')WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY FOUP_CATEGORY) END FOUP_LIST ,CASE WHEN COLOR = 'RED' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END RED_COUNT ,CASE WHEN COLOR = 'RED' THEN LISTAGG(FOUP_CATEGORY,',')WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY FOUP_CATEGORY) ELSE '' END RED_FOUP_LIST ,CASE WHEN COLOR = 'YELLOW' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END YELLOW_COUNT ,CASE WHEN COLOR = 'YELLOW' THEN LISTAGG(FOUP_CATEGORY,',')WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY FOUP_CATEGORY) ELSE '' END YELLOW_FOUP_LIST ,CASE WHEN COLOR = 'GREEN' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END GREEN_COUNT FROM( SELECT SHIFT_DATE,FOUP_CATEGORY,SAFETY_CAST,USER_FOUP_IN ,CASE WHEN USER_FOUP_IN < SAFETY_CAST * 0.8 THEN 'RED' WHEN USER_FOUP_IN < SAFETY_CAST THEN 'YELLOW' WHEN USER_FOUP_IN >= SAFETY_CAST THEN 'GREEN' END COLOR FROM( SELECT SHIFT_DATE,FAB,FOUP_CATEGORY,SAFETY_CAST,USER_FOUP_IN FROM A1_MFG.EMPTY_FOUP_DAILY WHERE SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-30,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24,'YYYYMMDD') )WHERE FAB = #{fab,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) GROUP BY SHIFT_DATE,COLOR )GROUP BY SHIFT_DATE )B ON A.SHIFT_DATE = B.SHIFT_DATE ORDER BY A.SHIFT_DATE
